Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Joseph Fischer
PRO
Gangrel antitribu
Capacity: 3
Group: 5
Independent anarch.

Muricia
ANI PRE SPI
Ahrimane
Capacity: 7
Group: 4
Sabbat: During your untap phase, a Gangrel antitribu you control may burn 1 blood to become a sterile Ahrimane and gain 1 level of Spiritus [spi] . +1 strength. Sterile.

When Joseph Fischer uses Muricia's special to become a sterile Ahrimane and gain 1 level of Spiritus [spi] , does he lose his Anarch status and become Sabbat?

Messages.Author: narpassword
Messages.Body:
10. Vampire Sects

If a vampire changes clans (by means of a Clan Impersonation card, for example) to a clan that belongs to a different sect, he changes sects as well.

Messages.Author: Timo
Messages.Body: So the answer is "yes Joseph becomes Sabbat if he becomes Arhimane"

Messages.Author: self biased
Messages.Body:
> Hakuron wrote:
> @Ankha: Does "default sect" still exist?
>
at the moment, technically yes.

The powers that be don't want to errata cards that they aren't going to reprint (which makes sense). However, when changes are made like this, some cards go into this weird limbo. Which is why making any sort of brad change to the rules is challenging, as there's 5,000+ cards in the set, and many many cards already printed out there.
